candidateVerdicts.reason: It is a narrow pre-routing observation point with a bounded output record, but it returns parse success and parsed values rather than a handled/consume decision. No evidenced return can consume a custom command silently.
Hooking it requires implementing the private Lua bridge ABI and still exposes parser results rather than a consume decision.
Its four builders create _comdebDEV, _comdebGM, _comdebTEST, and _comdebFUNC class names. It belongs to the GM/debug command surface, not ordinary player chat ingress, and returns no handled result.
The void __thiscall fire site dispatches a two-argument lifecycle callback and has no native handled return. The post and cancel callbacks are likewise void notifications.
It is downstream of successful parsing and does not receive parser-declined ordinary text or unknown slash input.
They are downstream send paths. Using them would require packet suppression or mutation, which is outside the requested contract.
